title: Warm Wholesome Thai Beef Grilled Chicken Kao Mun Gai
description: Energizing Thai dish featuring lean minced beef and grilled chicken, served on a fluffy bed of rice, infusing every bite with a hint of mustardy goodness.

ingredients.name: Lean Minced Beef
ingredients.notes: Choose 80% lean or higher for a leaner dish.

ingredients.name: Grilled Chicken Breast
ingredients.notes: Marinate in a mixture of soy sauce and fish sauce for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.notes: Jasmine or Thai jasmine rice works best for this dish.

ingredients.name: Kao Mun Gai Sauce
ingredients.notes: A mixture of fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.notes: For infusing oil for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grate fresh ginger for added depth.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince fresh garlic for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Green Chili Peppers
ingredients.notes: Slice fresh green chilies for added heat.

ingredients.name: Thai Basil
ingredients.notes: Chop fresh Thai basil for added freshness.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use flaky sea salt for added texture.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for added depth.

ingredients.name: Cedar Plank
ingredients.notes: Soak the plank in water for at least 30 minutes before use.

ingredients.name: Lime Wedges
ingredients.notes: Serve with lime wedges for added brightness.

instructions: Grill the chicken breast until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and saut2; for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the sliced green chilies and cook for an additional 2 minutes until tender.
Add the lean minced beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the kao mun gai sauce and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2-3 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Add the cooked chicken breast back to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
To serve, place the beef and chicken mixture on a bed of fluffy rice, garnished with chopped Thai basil and a sprinkle of flaky sea salt.
Serve with lime wedges on the side.
